[center][/center]
[left][size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Goldi's Honey Bear Clothing for Fashion Sense[/b] currently adds five new shirts, five new pants/skirts, and five new hats to Stardew Valley using [url=https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&rct=j&q=&esrc=s&source=web&cd=&cad=rja&uact=8&ved=2ahUKEwi8xu7A-viVAxWxMlkFHca6AqQQFnoECBoQAQ&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fmods%2F9969&usg=AOvVaw1kPwf7sy8LE2d9NRTAxG5h&opi=89978449]Fashion Sense[/url] and with [url=https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&rct=j&q=&esrc=s&source=web&cd=&cad=rja&uact=8&ved=2ahUKEwjklZrP-viVAxUWKFkFHaX-HroQFnoECBsQAQ&url=https%3A%2F%2Fblog.naver.com%2Fcodnjsdl8235%2F222314151470&usg=AOvVaw1YLb6Vrl0VAUVGMsgLbKS0&opi=89978449]GH's Peach Body Type[/url] in mind! Sleeve compatibility included. [i]Note that shoes/socks in screenshots are not included yet but are a WIP.[/i][/font][/color][/size][/left]

[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS]Currently,[b] Goldi's Honey Bear Clothing for Fashion Sense [/b]adds the following clothing items to the Fashion Sense mirror:[/font][/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][u][b]Shirts:[/b] Honey Bear Overall Top, Taupe Teddy Sweater, Bumblebee Babydoll Top, Flower Nectar Cardigan, Milk & Mead Dress Top[/u][/font][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][u][b]Pants:[/b] Honey Bear Overall Skirt, Taupe Teddy Mini Skirt, Bumblebee Shorts, Flower Nectar Midi Skirt, Milk & Mead Dress Bottom[/u][/font][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][u][u][b]Hats:[/b] Honey Bear Bandana, Taupe Teddy Beanie, Bumblebee Beekeeper Hat, Flower Nectar Daisy, Milk & Mead Headband[/u][/u][/font][/color][/size]

[u][color=#fff2cc][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Future Plans:[/b] [u][u]Honey Bear Ankle Boots, Taupe Teddy Socks, Bumblebee Striped Tights, Flower Nectar Flats, and Milk & Mead Shoes are currently being worked on! There's many, many animation frames for shoes, so please bear with me :)[/u][/u][/font][/size][/color][/u]
[line]
[u][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49541/49541-1785365173-1180323527.png[/img][/font][/color][/u]
[center][/center]
[left][size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Goldi's Honey Bear Clothing for Fashion Sense [/b]can be installed or uninstalled at any time during your playthrough![/font][/color][/size]
[/left]
[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS]1. Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]downloaded and have run it to install. Directions on how to do so can be found [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]here[/url]![/font][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS]2. Download, unzip, and drag [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] into your Stardew Valley mods folder OR download using a mod manager.[/font][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS]3. Download, unzip, and drag [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969?tab=files]Fashion Sense[/url] into your Stardew Valley mods folder OR download using a mod manager.[/font][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS]4. It is HIGHLY recommended (but not mandatory) that you download [url=https://m.blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]GH's Peach Body Type[/url] or another similar body mod. If you don't, the mod will still work, but the clothing may look strange at times.[/font][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS]5. Download this mod's file, unzip it, and drag it into your mods folder OR download using a mod manager.[/font][/color][/size]
[color=#fff2cc][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]6. Enjoy![/font][/size][/color]
[line]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49541/49541-1785366171-1286794978.png[/img]
[center][/center]
[left][color=#fff2cc][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Goldi's Honey Bear Clothing for Fashion Sense [/b]is compatible with any and all mods. However, some of the clothing may look wonky if you're not using [url=https://m.blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]GH's Peach Body Type[/url] (specifically the non-tall version) or a similar body mod. [/font][/size][/color]
[line]
[/left]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49541/49541-1785365469-1857526274.png[/img]
[center][/center]
[left][size=3][b][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS]Q: Will you include compatibility with the vanilla body/other body mods?[/font][/color][/b][/size][/left]
[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS]A: If there is enough demand for it, I may consider, but it's not at the top of my priority list right now![/font][/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Q: How do I use the clothing?
[/b]A: Use the Fashion Sense mirror to select the clothes from this mod! If you don't know how to get the mirror, please check that mod's page.[/font][/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Q: Why can't I change the color of the clothing?
[/b]A: I did this intentionally so that the clothing matches the golden/brown color scheme. I will not be making a colorable version at this time, sorry![/font][/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Q: Help! My farmer has no sleeves!
[/b]A: Please configure your body mod to toggle sleeves on. BOOM! Sleeves![/font][/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Q: The pants look strange when I sit/during certain animations...?
[/b]A: I'm working on adding frames for the new clothing for all necessary animations, but there's like probably over 100 lol. It'll take a little while for this mod to cover all bases. Please refrain from reporting these as bugs as they aren't game-breaking and I'm currently working on completing all frames![/font][/color][/size]

[color=#fff2cc][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Q: Where are the socks/shoes in the screenshots?
[/b]A: They're a WIP! I'll release an update when they're done. There's a lot of animation frames, so please be patient :3[/font][/size][/color]

[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Q: Your mod wrecked my farmer's body! They're purple and growing tendrils!
[/b]A: Sorry to hear. All my mod does is add clothing for use with Fashion Sense and provides sleeve compatibility if your body mod supports that. Feel free to let me know about your issue, but it's probably not my mod causing it.[/font][/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Q: What other mods are used in your screenshots?
[/b]A: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19125?tab=files]Churpy's Vivid Hairstyles[/url] for the hair and [url=https://m.blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]GH's Peach Body Type[/url] for the body/skin/eyes/sleeves![/font][/color][/size]

[color=#fff2cc][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Please feel free to leave other questions in the comments section![/font][/size][/color]
[line]
[color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49541/49541-1785365723-147231900.png[/img][/font][/color]
[left][size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS]As always, all downloads, endorsements, kind words, and constructive criticism is appreciated![/font][/color][/size][/left]

[color=#fff2cc][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Special shoutout to the creators of SMAPI, Content Patcher, Fashion Sense, and GH's Peach Body Type![/font][/size][/color]
